projecthero.guide.omnitrix.alien.echo_ec: A Sonorosian: a small white sound-maker who splits into copies of himself. Sonic screams, a wide blast, rings of sound and a focused cannon -- and every clone screams with him. Up to three clones follow him, can be sent at a target or swapped places with, and merge back to heal him; his ultimate splits into a full chorus and blasts a dome of sound. Water muffles him.
projecthero.omnitrix.info.echo_echo.role: Sonic duplicator: screams, sound waves and a chorus of clones.
projecthero.omnitrix.info.echo_echo.pass: Duplication: up to 3 clones follow him (V); his screams, rings and cannon come from every clone too.
Small and quick: x0.6 size, x1.15 speed, short falls do him no harm.
projecthero.omnitrix.info.echo_echo.weak: Water: in it he takes 25% more damage and his screams do half.
Fragile: only 16 health, and each clone breaks after 6 damage.
projecthero.omnitrix.echo_echo.sonic_scr: A sound wave along your look, 14 blocks: 7 damage and knocked back. Each clone screams at the same spot for 3.
projecthero.omnitrix.echo_echo.sonic_bla: A wide cone of sound, 10 blocks: 14 damage and hurled back. Clones add 3 each.
projecthero.omnitrix.echo_echo.echo_ring: A ring of sound bursts out round you (12 in 5 blocks) and round every clone (3 in 3).
projecthero.omnitrix.echo_echo.disorient: A droning hum, 7 blocks: 5 damage, nausea and slowness, and anything hunting you loses track.
projecthero.omnitrix.echo_echo.sonic_lea: A blast of sound at the ground throws you up and forward; no fall damage for 1.5 s.
projecthero.omnitrix.echo_echo.echo_swap: Change places with your farthest clone.
projecthero.omnitrix.echo_echo.sound_bar: 3 s of a sonic shell: half damage, creatures pushed off, arrows and shots turned back.
projecthero.omnitrix.echo_echo.echo_assa: Every clone dashes at the creature you look at (16 blocks) and screams point blank: 6 damage each.
projecthero.omnitrix.echo_echo.duplicate: Split off a clone (up to 3). Clones follow you, scream with you and last until you turn back or they break (6 damage).
projecthero.omnitrix.echo_echo.merge.des: Call your clones back into you: +2 health for each.
projecthero.omnitrix.echo_echo.sonic_can: A focused beam of sound, 24 blocks, through everything in the line: 16 damage. Clones add 3 each.
projecthero.omnitrix.echo_echo.ultimate_: ULTIMATE: split into a full chorus of three, a 1 s build-up, then a dome of sound -- 50 damage at the centre, 40 at the 10-block edge.
message.projecthero.omnitrix.echo_echo.n: You have no clones -- split one off first (V).
No creature in sight for your clones.
